# get_periodic_map { #mofography.compute.get_periodic_map }

```python
compute.get_periodic_map(
    regions,
    maxima,
    maxima_radii,
    ase_atoms,
    return_conn=False,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Map each region label to its periodic representative (optional connectivity groups).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type   | Description                                                                                             | Default    |
|--------------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| regions      |        | a 3D array of integers, where each integer is a region index, obtained from regions_from_dgrid function | _required_ |
| maxima       |        | the 3D indices of the maxima, obtained from regions_from_dgrid function                                 | _required_ |
| maxima_radii |        | the list of radii of the maxima (in Angstrom)                                                           | _required_ |
| return_conn  |        | if True, returns the connectivity groups of the regions, defaults to False (optional)                   | `False`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | a dictionary with the keys being the starting region indices and the values being the periodic group of the regions.  then to apply this periodic map to regions, use:     np.vectorize(periodic_map.get)(regions) |
